info.name: KEFEX API — Resource-based CRUD
info.description: Organized by backend resource and matching descriptive file names. Uses exact mounts from server.js. For token-free LOCAL development only, enable POSTMAN_AUTH_BYPASS=true in backend and use X-Dev-Role on protected requests. Otherwise add a valid Bearer token.

request.description: Confirms the API process is responding.
Process health only; it does not independently verify MongoDB state.

item.name: Auth — User
item.description: Public registration and login; public registration always creates role user.

request.description: Creates a normal user. Password minimum 8 characters.
Alias for registration.
Login body expects username (email) and password.
Returns token in data field when credentials are valid.

item.name: Auth — Admin
item.description: Admin login accepts only existing accounts whose MongoDB role is admin. There is intentionally no public admin registration.

request.description: Credentials must belong to an active admin account.
